title: About Me
subtitle: Clinical psychologist and integrative psychotherapist
introduction: I am Valeria Maria Stănculea, a clinical psychologist and integrative psychotherapist with recognized practice rights from the Romanian Psychologists' College. I work with children, adolescents, parents and families, with a special focus on evaluation and psychotherapeutic intervention for children aged 4 to 10 years.

education.title: Education and Certifications
education.bachelor: Bachelor's Degree in Psychology, Alexandru Ioan Cuza University, 2018
education.master: Master's in Clinical Psychology and Child and Family Psychotherapy, University of Bucharest, 2023
education.additional: Courses and supervision in Experiential Assessment, Play Therapy Interventions, Parental Counseling

experience.title: Professional Experience
experience.private: Private practice - Clinical psychologist and psychotherapist
experience.privateDesc: Psychological assessment and psychotherapeutic intervention for children, adolescents and families, with a focus on behavioral difficulties, anxiety, high-functioning autism and relational challenges.
experience.fdpDesc: Psychological assessment and educational interventions for children with special needs, including parental guidance and multidisciplinary collaboration.
experience.abaDesc: Implementation of behavioral intervention plans for autistic children, with training and supervision in ABA techniques.

specializations.title: Areas of Expertise
specializations.behavioral: Behavioral disorders: oppositional defiant disorder, conduct disorder
specializations.emotional: Emotional disorders: depression, anxiety, tics, selective mutism
specializations.trauma: Developmental trauma, adopted children, impact of separations

approach.title: How I Work
approach.description: I offer a therapeutic framework of trust and stability for child and family. The theoretical approach is integrative-relational: the child is understood in their uniqueness, and interventions combine cognitive, emotional and behavioral components, adapted to age and needs.
approach.playTherapy: Working with children includes play therapy as the central modality for exploration and regulation, and family involvement is an integral part of the support and change process.
